place.name: Phisqa Tira
place.description: Phisqa Tira (Aymara phisqa five, tira cradle, "five cradles", Hispanicized spelling Piscatira) is a mountain in the Andes of Peru, about 5,000 metres (16,404 ft) high. It is located in the Puno Region, Lampa Province, on the border of the districts Paratía and Santa Lucía.
